verdict.rationale: Greptile documents an official MCP server (mcp-v2) supporting OAuth connections from Cursor, Claude Code, VS Code, and Codex, letting agents fetch PR comments and apply fixes; a runtime probe confirms the remote MCP server completes a full JSON-RPC initialize handshake with proper serverInfo and tools capability. Missing for 10: independent third-party corroboration of real-world agent usage via MCP beyond vendor docs/probe.
